entities.summary: The Roman Catholic Diocese of Kabale is a diocese of the Catholic Church in Uganda. The diocese was established on 17 April 1966, being carved out from the Roman Catholic Diocese of Mbarara. It is a suffragan diocese of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Mbarara.
